up-to-seven.l: Number of tumors. Each tumor adds 1 to the sum, including the largest.
Diameter of the LARGEST tumor. ONLY THIS SIZE ENTERS THE SUM - do not sum the diameters of the others.
GROSS (macro) vascular invasion - what imaging can actually show. This is NOT microvascular invasion, which the published criterion assumes absent and which cannot be assessed before transplant.
Extrahepatic spread. Present places the patient outside these criteria regardless of the sum.
